_doc: Shown in muted text under the timer on a walk; one is picked per walk. Original lines, so there's nothing to misattribute.
quotes: Small steps still get you up the hill.
You don't have to finish today. You just have to keep walking.
Slow progress is still progress.
One page, one problem, one paragraph at a time.
The best time to start was earlier. The next best time is now.
Focus is a muscle. This is the workout.
Nobody remembers the walk being hard. They remember the view.
Do the next small thing.
Future you is already grateful.
Every minute here is a minute that counts.
Messy work is still work. Tidy it later.
You've started. That was the hardest part.
Keep the lead loose and the mind clear.
Big things are just small things, stacked up.
Breathe out. Carry on.
Consistency beats intensity.
A little every day goes a long way.
It doesn't need to be perfect. It needs to be done.
Stay on the path. The scenery will take care of itself.
Your companion believes in you. So should you.
Good work is quiet. Keep going.
The view gets better the further you walk.
One more stretch, then a well-earned rest.
Done is a lovely word. Let's get there.
Curiosity first, perfection later.
Trust the process; enjoy the walk.
